content: TEST-01 target verified by reading src/AkariTool.App/ViewModels/Tweaks/SettingBadgeCalculator.cs: line 15 'public static class SettingBadgeCalculator' in namespace AkariTool.ViewModels.Tweaks, and lines 17-27 'public static IReadOnlyList<BadgePillState> Compute(SettingDefinition definition, InputType inputType, bool isOn, int selectedIndex, int numericValue, int acNumericValue, int dcNumericValue, bool hasBattery, bool supportsSeparateACDC)'. D-02's public-static-and-pure assumption is VERIFIED: 9 parameters, no I/O, no dispatcher, no XAML type. It is not dependency-free: lines 381-383 ConvertFromSystemUnits calls AkariTool.Infrastructure.Features.Common.Utilities.NumericConversionHelper.ConvertFromSystemUnits(systemValue, definition.NumericRange?.Units), reachable transitively via AkariTool.App -> AkariTool.Infrastructure, so the test project cannot be Core-only. Subtlety the characterization test should freeze: line 30 guards on definition.InputType == InputType.Action, reading the DEFINITION's InputType rather than the inputType parameter, so a test passing inputType Toggle with a definition whose InputType is Action gets an empty list. BadgePillState is 'public sealed record BadgePillState(SettingBadgeKind Kind, bool IsHighlighted, string Label, string Tooltip, SettingBadgeMode Mode = SettingBadgeMode.None)' in Core. The two existing test csproj shapes are 23- and 24-line Microsoft.NET.Sdk projects: TargetFramework net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0, Nullable enable, ImplicitUsings enable, IsPackable false, IsTestProject true, and 5 package refs (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.14.1, xunit 2.9.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.5, FluentAssertions 8.7.1, NSubstitute 5.3.0). InternalsVisibleTo is NOT needed for a public type; AkariTool.App.csproj currently has none, so it would have to be added if ever required (Core and Infrastructure both have the precedent).
